title: Warm Yeasty British Potatoes Bubble And Squeak
description: A hearty British dish featuring tender potatoes, chives, and a hint of yeast, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Boil the diced potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to cool.
In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the diced onion until softened.
Add the chopped chives, yeast extract, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the diced candy cap mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the cooked potatoes to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and mushroom mixture.
Use a spatula to shape the mixture into a flat cake and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the bubble and squeak hot, garnished with additional chopped chives if desired.
